notes.tests: tests/ exists (pytest, pytest.ini: testpaths=tests, pythonpath=.). 14 test files covering nuts_calc.py, nuts_calc_tex.py (unit-level; the pdflatex-dependent CLI tests skip when pdflatex is absent), and web/backend. Verified by running 'pytest -q' on this branch (2026-08-05): 196 tests, 187 passed, 9 failed. The 9 failures are in tests/test_nuts_calc_init.py and are pre-existing/known: they assert bare `exit()` (SystemExit(None)) for validation failures that nuts_calc.py's _init() now raises as `exit(1)` (fixed in issue #37); the test file's own docstring and docs/L3_implementation/nuts_calc.py.md:55 document this as stale test expectations, reproducible on main, unrelated to any change on this branch.
notes.known_defects: None currently known. The previously-tracked web/frontend build failure (missing i18next dependencies) is resolved: package.json lists i18next/react-i18next/i18next-browser-languagedetector/i18next-http-backend, and 'npm install && npm run build' was re-verified to succeed on this branch (2026-08-05). See docs/L3_implementation/specification_summary.md. Separately, tests/test_nuts_calc_init.py has 9 known-stale failing tests (see notes.tests above) that are not a defect in nuts_calc.py itself.
notes.nuts_calc_tex_py: Experimental LaTeX-rendered prototype (see docs/L3_implementation/nuts_calc_tex.py.md), zero code sharing with nuts_calc.py. Requires pdflatex (texlive-latex-base + texlive-latex-extra). Vendors the CTAN 'longdivision' package at vendor/texmf/tex/latex/longdivision/ (not bundled with Ubuntu's texlive-latex-extra); 'xlop' is assumed available from the standard texlive-latex-extra package. Not called by web/backend/app.py directly -- web/backend/renderers.py can select it via the NUTS_CALC_RENDERER=latex env var (issue #36).
